title: The Symbol Game: A First Game with S(n), MSS-N, and Basic Packets
description: An introduction to the Symbol Game using S(n), MSS-N, and basic packets. Eight gradual examples drawn from the S(n), MSS-N, and audited Genesis curricula teach compact notation, ground counts, observational separation, consistent renaming, typed prompts and candidate answers, returned-packet value and replay, bounded sessions, and extension round trips. Self-contained code and a standalone Jupyter workbook include positive and changed-input controls. Appendix A previews the advanced mathematical and practical routes.
